description: This file implements the TensorFlow session management API in Go, including creation, execution, and device listing functionalities.

classes.name: Session
classes.description: Represents an active TensorFlow session for executing graphs.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Contains information about devices available to the session.

classes.name: PartialRun
classes.description: Allows incremental execution of a TensorFlow graph.

methods.name: NewSession
methods.description: Creates a new TensorFlow session bound to a graph, with optional configurations.

methods.name: ListDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of devices associated with the session.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the graph with provided feeds and fetches the results.

methods.name: NewPartialRun
methods.description: Sets up the session for incremental evaluation.

methods.name: PartialRun.Run
methods.description: Executes a partial run with additional feeds, fetches, and targets.
